plugin.name: DuckStation
plugin.description: DuckStation in the Mire store: installed from its official GitHub page, with the PlayStation console and a BIOS reminder. Mire never provides any BIOS.

duckstation.name: DuckStation
duckstation.description: PlayStation. Needs the BIOS from your console, placed in its "bios" folder.
duckstation.bios: The BIOS from your PlayStation: scph1001.bin, scph5501.bin, scph7001.bin… (required).
